findings: Expired socket timeout could become a nonblocking read of queued data: explicit monotonic gates now precede read/write and publication after hashing/source checks.
A multi-read truncated unknown route underreported consumed bytes: the bounded drain now returns the exact consumed count on every path.
The old checker did not directly assert ACK/ledger count and hash fields: the final checker parses both and checks all ten ledger rows.

immutable_prior_helper.scope: Earlier no-sink helper epoch and five same-input browser lifecycle comparisons remain unchanged. Their browser observations and v2 window/CDP diagnostic boundary were not rerun or rebound to the new helper image.

capabilities_and_limits.configuration: Optional post_sinks array of exact url/root/file/max_bytes mappings; no request URL-derived output path.
capabilities_and_limits.publication: Exclusive same-parent mktemp staging, bounded NUL-safe chunks, exact count/SHA256 and source/path/deadline admission before atomic rename.
capabilities_and_limits.body_deadline: 30-second monotonic admission includes body reception, hashing and source/path checks through publication admission. Queued transport data cannot waive expiry. Individual platform filesystem effects are not preempted.
capabilities_and_limits.HTTP: One request per connection, Content-Length framing, immediate read-ahead surplus refused, no accepted pipelines. Future bytes outside Content-Length are not part of the declared upload.
capabilities_and_limits.filesystem: Caller-owned fixture trees. No hostile local filesystem race sandbox or filesystem crash durability claim.
capabilities_and_limits.ledger: Complete ACK remains truthful after successful atomic publication if a later ledger append fails. Final origin qualification then fails. No transaction across output+ledger.
capabilities_and_limits.platform_effects: Existing bounded direct /usr/bin/mktemp and /bin/chmod effects have exact image hashes in the receipt. No new native effects, shell/Python/TypeScript orchestration or product policy.
